parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Ammonia is converted into nitric acid. The first stage of this conversion uses a catalyst and occurs at a temperature of 900 ° C and a pressure of 5 atmospheres. 4NH 3 (g) + 5O 2 (g) 4NO(g) + 6H 2 O(g) The forward reaction is exothermic.
